accepted.titleZh: 利用有机溶剂经氧化–Cope消除途径升级回收环氧树脂
accepted.reason: 作者团队公开论文列表将该题名明确列为CCS Chemistry论文；同一作者团队、同一氧化–Cope环氧树脂工作公开前体全文显示，DMSO/空气可选择性断裂胺固化环氧网络中的C–N键，并用于环氧树脂及商业纤维增强复合材料的化学解构与降解产物回收。这一主要贡献属于具有可迁移性的聚合物化学转化/升级回收方法，而不是仅以材料性能为终点的制样研究。
accepted.evidenceBasis: 大连理工大学翁志焕课题组论文列表记录完全一致的最终题名并标记CCS Chemistry Accepted；Francisco Zaera/Xiaotong Pan等作者的公开文献档案同时列出该CCS Chemistry论文与前体预印本“Breaking of C-N bonds in epoxy resins via an oxidation-Cope elimination pathway”。公开前体全文给出DMSO/空气中的N-oxide→Cope消除选择性C–N断裂、模型化合物机理证据、胺固化环氧树脂与商业复合材料适用性，以及可分离降解产物的回收与结构表征。因此此前所缺的实际产物、键变化、材料范围与分离/物料证据已被文章特定的匹配前体证据补齐；不把预印本中的数值机械宣称为最终版新增数据。
accepted.challengeReason: 最强反向理由是论文面向复合材料回收，且包含纤维回收、胶黏剂应用和生命周期评价；这些应用本身不能作为收录依据。但其核心新方法是对交联胺固化环氧网络执行选择性氧化–Cope C–N断裂，公开前体还展示多类环氧树脂/商业复合材料和可回收的化学降解产物，已经超过“材料制样/性能研究”边界，满足聚合物化学转化的一般制备证据。

decisionReuse.conclusion: 补审取得与最终CCS Chemistry论文明确匹配的作者团队论文列表及同工作公开前体全文；此前关于实际断键、产物、范围和回收证据的缺口已实质补齐，因此由pending转include。

scopeAssessment.primaryContribution: 建立以DMSO/空气驱动氧化–Cope消除、选择性切断胺固化环氧网络C–N键的化学解构与升级回收方法。
scopeAssessment.preparativeTransformation: 交联环氧网络中的叔胺位点先氧化为N-oxide，再发生Cope消除并断裂C–N键，形成含羟胺主链和末端羰基特征的可溶性降解产物，同时释放纤维组分。
scopeAssessment.generalityEvidence: 与最终CCS Chemistry题名相匹配的公开前体全文覆盖胺固化环氧树脂及商业纤维增强环氧复合材料，并显示降解产物可通过沉淀、过滤和干燥回收；公开摘要还明确称方法可扩展至含叔胺结构的其他聚合物。这里以化学解构范围和可回收产物为一般性依据，不以胶黏性能或生命周期指标替代。
scopeAssessment.sourceEvidence: DUT作者主页将完全一致的最终题名列为CCS Chemistry论文；ResearchGate作者档案同时列出该最终论文和同主题前体预印本；前体公开全文直接给出氧化–Cope机理、模型化合物、环氧树脂/商业复合材料解构和降解产物回收/表征事实。
scopeAssessment.boundaryChallenge: 论文具有明显的材料循环利用场景，但核心新增能力不是膜/器件/性能调控，而是可迁移的交联聚合物选择性化学断键与产物回收方法，因此按scope-2026-10-02-v1纳入。

The primary objectives were to determine the maximum administered dose (MAD) in the dose escalation phase and the objective response rate (ORR) in the dose expansion. Eleven patients were enrolled in the dose escalation cohort, and 12 patients were treated in the dose expansion cohort at the MAD of 3 ×10 7 cells/injection. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint for ORR as no objective responses were observed, though 36.8% of patients achieved a best response of stable disease. Disease stability was associated with increased T cell receptor diversity and greater expansion of novel clones following therapy. rejected.title: A family of small proteins links c-di-GMP riboswitch signaling with sporulation in Clostridioides difficile
rejected.abstract: Abstract Cyclic diguanosine monophosphate (c-di-GMP) is a second messenger that coordinates lifestyle transitions, virulence, and developmental processes in bacteria. In Clostridioides difficile , elevated c-di-GMP levels inhibit sporulation, but the underlying mechanism remained unclear. Here, we identified a conserved family of small, membrane-associated proteins encoded by c-di-GMP riboswitch-regulated genes. Transcriptomic analyses revealed that c-di-GMP represses these genes, and reporter assays demonstrated riboswitch-dependent transcriptional regulation via premature termination mechanism. Overexpression of a single gene, CD1980.2 , was sufficient to trigger the transcriptional activation of sporulation genes, including sigma factors and their regulons, and to increase spore formation. Conversely, sporulation efficiency decreased proportionally with the number of deleted small-protein genes, and the strain lacking all seven genes displayed a severe sporulation defect, underscoring their cumulative and functionally redundant roles. Elevating c-di-GMP levels in the deletion mutant did not further reduce sporulation, supporting a model in which c-di-GMP inhibits spore formation by repressing the expression of this small-protein family. Thus, our work establishes these small proteins, encoded by c-di-GMP riboswitch-regulated genes, as important regulators of spore formation

rejected.title: Multivalent antiviral conjugates enhance activity against Influenza via cross-linking viruses
rejected.abstract: Abstract Long-acting drug–Fc conjugate (CD388) has emerged as a new class of antivirals against influenza A and B, yet the mechanisms governing how Fc conjugation reshapes small-molecule function remain undefined. Here we establish a programmable multivalent antiviral conjugates (AVCs) platform by click chemistry that enables flexible combination of valencies and conjugated drugs, allowing systematic interrogation of valency-dependent antiviral mechanisms. Using zanamivir as a model, mono-, di-, and trivalent zanamivir are conjugated with Fc, with trivalent zanamivir-Fc conjugates (AVC-Z3) exhibiting higher activity than lower-valent AVCs. AVC-Z3 induces inter-virion aggregation, thereby coupling blockade of viral entry with restriction of viral release. This cross-linking–mediated dual-stage inhibition represents a mechanistic shift from neuraminidase suppression to physical viral immobilization. Furthermore, trivalent peramivir-Fc conjugate (AVC-P3) is synthesised and exhibits stronger antiviral activity than AVC-Z3 in vitro, with much longer half-life in vivo than AVC-Z3, and CD388 with YTE mutation. The in vivo antivirus efficacy of AVC-P3 surpasses other AVCs, baloxavir, and CD388 in H1N1-, H3N2-, H5N1-, and influenza B-infection mice models. Together, our findings define ligand valency as a determinant of antiviral mechanism.

rejected.evidenceBasis: fresh compact完整摘要明确比较单/二/三价扎那米韦–Fc及三价帕拉米韦–Fc，核心结果为病毒聚集、进入/释放抑制、半衰期和小鼠疗效；点击化学是构建平台的既有手段，摘要未建立新的通用有机成键方法或独立制备范围。
rejected.challengeReason: 多价偶联物确实被实际合成，且价态/药物可编程是反向纳入证据；但论文回答的是Fc偶联如何改变抗病毒机制与药效，而非发展可推广的新有机反应，故排除。

scopeAssessment.primaryContribution: 阐明多价药物–Fc偶联物通过交联病毒改变抗流感机制并提升体内疗效。
scopeAssessment.preparativeTransformation: 使用点击化学把扎那米韦或帕拉米韦以不同价态接到Fc上；这是实际制备但非摘要所主张的新反应方法。
scopeAssessment.generalityEvidence: 摘要只展示两类已知抗病毒药和价态变化，评价集中于病毒聚集、半衰期及动物疗效，未给出一般有机底物范围。
scopeAssessment.sourceEvidence: Nature Communications/Crossref完整摘要列出AVC-Z3、AVC-P3、病毒交联与小鼠流感模型结果。
scopeAssessment.boundaryChallenge: 真实偶联操作不自动把化学生物学平台变成一般有机合成方法；主要贡献和证据终点均为抗病毒机制。
